# 7-Min Scientific Workout and Fitness Magazine

> > Science-backed 7-minute HIIT workout platform and fitness magazine offering interval training routines, nutrition guides, and healthy aging content for 127+ countries.

Based on research from the American College of Sports Medicine and featured in the New York Times, 7-Min provides efficient bodyweight workouts and evidence-based health guidance. The platform emphasizes High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) for time-efficient fitness, alongside nutrition advice for weight loss, anti-aging, and healthy living after 50.

## Key Topics

- HIIT (High Intensity Interval Training)
- 7-minute workout
- Scientific 7-Minute Workout
- Bodyweight exercises
- Interval training
- Weight loss
- American College of Sports Medicine
- New York Times workout
- Healthy aging & anti-aging
- Nutrition after 50
- Brain health (Alzheimer's & Parkinson's prevention)
- Anti-inflammation diet
- Heart rate training zones
- Workout timer & exercise videos
